profile.headline: Software Engineer at Magnitude
profile.summary:
Experienced multilingual (English, Japanese and Korean) software engineer who writes reliable, secure and scalable code.

Skill set includes, but not limited to: 
• React
• JavaScript
• Next.js
• Chakra UI 
• TypeScript 
• GraphQL

My strengths:
• Very fast learner
• Not afraid to tackle new, unchartered territory
• Creative, love to find solutions to emerging problems
• Great all-around communicator
• Excellent team player
• Proven track record in forming high functioning / performing team

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
• Collaborate with design and product teams to translate UI/UX wireframes into scalable and reusable frontend components.
• Design and develop intuitive, responsive, and high-performance user interfaces using React, TypeScript, and Node.js.
• Work cross-functionally with other engineers to design and implement seamless integration between frontend and backend services.
• Optimize frontend performance to ensure seamless user experiences across devices and browsers. Implement and integrate APIs using GraphQL and Java Spring Boot to support dynamic frontend functionality.
• Participate in code reviews and enforce coding standards to ensure maintainable and efficient frontend codebases.
• Troubleshoot and resolve production issues related to frontend applications efficiently.
• Drive frontend testing strategies using unit, integration, and end-to-end testing tools.
• Lead technical discussions and contribute to architectural decisions with a focus on frontend scalability and best practices.

positions.title: Co-Founder and Lead Engineer
positions.locationName: San Francisco, California, United States · Hybrid
positions.description:
• Co-founded Fenyx Labs, leading the development of a web application for athlete posture analysis.  
• Engineered the back-end infrastructure using AWS services, enhancing scalability and performance.  
• Developed a user-friendly front-end with React and TypeScript, improving user engagement.
• Delivered a Minimum Viable Product (MVP) in under two months, demonstrating rapid execution.
positions.insights: Skills: React.js · TypeScript · Next.js · JavaScript · Amazon Web Services (AWS) · Chakra UI

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
Collaborated with a US and German engineering team, created b2b project management application “Goldn” allowing users to create cosmetics product from start to finish.

•	Implemented queries using GraphQL, Apollo and SWR
•	Debugged back-end data using PostgreSQL
•	Created components using Chakra UI
•	Developed Ideation Board using dnd kit with masonry layout
•	Participated in implementing Stripe to process orders
•	Launched product within the projected deadline
•	Assisted back-end engineer by debugging code written in Go
•	Connect “Goldn” with commerce platform Vendure
•	Successfully coordinated work between US and German teams to ensure a seamless development despite geographic and time zone challenges
positions.insights: Skills: Git · JavaScript · TypeScript · Next.js · Apollo GraphQL · Google Cloud Platform (GCP) · React.js · GraphQL

positions.title: Full Stack Engineer
positions.description:
As a full stack LAMP developer, focused on FE/UX using JS/CSS/HTML, WordPress and CMS. Built and maintained brand sites such as Fresh Step and Kingsford. Supported UX teams, technical leads and systems administrators during deployments and updates.

•	Was offered and accepted full-time position after working as a contractor
•	Revised/streamlined workflow and projects, e.g., shortening development of an internal file sharing system from 4 months to 1 month

positions.title: Senior Engineer
positions.locationName: 1175 Folsom St, San Francisco, CA 94103 · On-site
positions.description:
Reviewed and improved DaCast Player Framework. Introduced best practices and provided mentorship to junior engineers.

•	Developed and upgraded existing video player using Video JS for DaCast Player Framework
•	Introduced new framework using React as a tech stack
•	Improved team productivity by initiating documentation of tools and creating recyclable Jira tickets template
•	Familiarized sales and product team with the software
•	Mentored junior engineer

positions.title: Full-Stack Software Engineer
positions.locationName: 340 Brannan Street, Suite 100, San Francisco, CA, 94103 · On-site
positions.description:
Worked as a software engineer in addition to acting as a project leader/manager and business liaison collaborating with Japanese customers. Created digital comics service Crunchyroll Manga from the ground up.

•	Created web comics viewer using ActionScript, JavaScript, PHP, MySQL, HTML and CSS
•	Developed joint venture digital comic publishing platform JManga
•	Established back-end content management system to maintain quality of digital contents
•	Implemented royalty report generator
•	Led a team to design digital comics viewer for iOS and Android, orchestrating the full cycle of product development
•	Implemented a back-end linking CMS and mobile applications for Crunchyroll Manga
•	Implemented and launched VRV, a video streaming subscription service using React and Redux
•	Identified and communicated technical and business needs of Japanese clients which led to deals with one of the largest Japanese publisher Kodansha and other content providers

positions.locationName: 1740 Technology Dr #600, San Jose, CA 95110 · On-site

positions.title: Senior Engineer
positions.description:
Acted as a team lead providing mentorship to engineers. Developed hand-held video games using J2ME, BREW and C++. Designed solutions for delivering applications to devices with extreme limitations.

• Developed network-based billiard video game Pool Pro Online 2 to over one hundred types of handheld devices
• Received Silver Award (January 2008) for outstanding performance in Bandai Namco Value, Financial Impact, Leadership Value and Customer Centricity

positions.title: Engineer
positions.description:
• Developed network-based quiz game Scene It? TV Edition
• Ported games to mobile devices (Pac-Man, Ms. Pac-Man, Galaga, Snoopy – The Flying Ace)
